Drought indicator

Select a layer above. Indicators marked queryable can be clicked on the map for the value at that point (via the live Copernicus WMS GetFeatureInfo request) — others are visual-only.

River & rainfall stations — England & Scotland (live)

Town search matches English (EA) station records. For Scotland, pan/zoom the map there and use "Find UK stations near map centre" — it queries EA and SEPA live in parallel within ~20–25 km. Wales (NRW) and Northern Ireland (DfI Rivers) don't offer a no-key, embeddable live feed, so those show as links to the official viewers instead — see the note below each.

Reservoir stocks (manual entry)

No open, live UK reservoir-stock API exists — the Environment Agency publishes these monthly as PDF/CSV in the Water Situation national monthly report. Enter the latest figures here each month to keep the chart current.
Drought indicators: © European Commission / Joint Research Centre, Copernicus European & Global Drought Observatories (EDO/GDO) — drought.emergency.copernicus.eu
Hydrology data: Environment Agency (England) real-time flood-monitoring & hydrology APIs, and SEPA (Scotland) Time Series Data Service — both Open Government Licence v3.0
Wales (Natural Resources Wales) and Northern Ireland (DfI Rivers) link to their official viewers — see README
